title: SKE Bar Lemon & Lime Prefilled Vape Pod
description: Designed for the SKE Bar Prefilled Pod Kit, this Lemon and Lime pod delivers a sharp, zesty citrus flavour with a smooth, refreshing finish. The vibrant notes of Lemon are bright and punchy, while the Lime brings a tangy sweetness that makes this a lively, palate-cleansing vape. Each 2ml pod is filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and powered by mesh coil technology for a smooth and flavour-rich MTL experience. Please Note: These are pods ONLY and the Battery is not included.
